accepted.quote: The Republican bill also includes draconian policies to ban taxpaying, lawfully present individuals from accessing coverage under Medicare and the ACA.
accepted.rationale: The legislator characterizes the restriction on Medicare and ACA coverage as draconian, indicating opposition.

accepted.quote: But this bill is a hack job disguised as surgery, delivering the actual or functional repeal of most of these credits.
accepted.rationale: The legislator condemns the bill for repealing clean energy credits, indicating opposition to the repeal.

accepted.quote: Republicans preach fiscal responsibility under Democrats, then explode the deficit the moment tax handouts for billionaires are on the table, putting our nation on a fast track to fiscal calamity.
accepted.rationale: The legislator argues the bill would substantially increase the deficit, indicating opposition on fiscal grounds.
